response.sql:
WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UA > 3.9
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_patient_avg_hgb,
    AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM patient_averages;

assumptions.assumption: Patients with qualifying records are included in each overall average only when that patient's corresponding per-patient average is non-NULL; SQL AVG ignores missing values, including when either HGB or APTT-minus-PT is unavailable.
